title: XXXIX. Of A Chriſtian man's Oath.

segments.text:
AS we confeſs that vain & raſh Swearing is forbidden Chriſtian men by our Lord Jeſus Chriſt, & James His Apoſtle; ſo we judge that Chriſtian Religion doth not prohibit, but that a man
may Swear when the Magiſtrate requireth, in a Cauſe of Faith and Charity, ſo it be done according to the Prophet's Teaching, in Juſtice, Judgment, and Truth.
